reviews.review_msg: Entertaining speaker if you're interested in the subject matter, probably pretty easy to nap through if you're not. Tests are in class essays that you get about 45 minutes per essay, which is gonna hurt if you can't write fast. Got a great TA in the class which makes the tutorials fun. The tutorials are marked, but super easy work.

Teaches very well and encourages back and forth communication in lectures to discuss many points of view and our understanding. Very interesting topics in this class. Simple 10min assignments every tutorial based on readings and lecture and 2 essays, NO TESTS! My TA was also a very cool chill guy that was also good at teaching and deeper thinking.

Unless you are a very abstract thinker and have incredible patience, this class is not for you. The lectures are incredibly boring, just talking about the reading material, and getting student opinions on it. The tests are also very demanding, complex topics and if you are not a fast writer you will struggle; 2 essays in a 1.5hr period.
